task: Spoken order from the warehouse operator: "rone get the get the strawberry and the beer from the top shelf.". The strawberry and the pear are on the top shelf (1.3 m high), out of the arm's reach. Bring them into the tray at the packing station. The drone can scout the stations; the ground robot carries one item at a time. Wind may be blowing.
